description: Snapshot of the ACE fixture trajectory analyses: Fe_up-O g(r) peak (compute_rdf defaults: LAST 20 frames, r_max 6.0, 200 bins) and the MSD endpoints of Fe_up and O over all 350 frames with pbc (T,T,T). In this fixture the last 20 frames (steps 3400-3587) are the tail of the final minimize/box-relax phase, so the g(r) first peak sits in a single bin.
source: snapshot: values produced by this repository at baseline_commit on 2026-10-31 (Python 3.14.4, NumPy 2.3.5, scipy present). The RDF peak and MSD(Fe_up) agree with the values quoted in tests/test_regression_numeric.py comments (AUDIT-20261027 re-baseline). A PASS means the output is unchanged since baseline_commit; it is not evidence that the numbers are physically right (see features/fixture-ace-rdf-msd.md Gotchas: affine cell motion is not subtracted from the MSD, dt_fs heuristic differs from the run).

sources.rdf_frames_timestep_range: fixture: the last 20 TIMESTEP headers of traj.dump are 3400..3587 (grep, no repository code); pins that compute_rdf uses the last max_frames frames
sources.rdf_feup_o_peak_r: snapshot; tolerance half a bin (0.015 A) because bin centres come from linspace. Neighbouring bins 1.845 and 1.905 are exactly 0 at baseline; relaxed Fe_up-O distances are 1.8828-1.8849 A, 0.005 A below the 1.89 bin edge
sources.rdf_feup_o_peak_g: snapshot; rel 1e-8 covers summation-order differences across BLAS/SIMD builds
sources.msd_feup_endpoint: snapshot; current-frame-length unwrap of wrapped x y z; includes affine NPT box-scaling motion
